messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for synth-canary-eu-west-1 (probe-v2) — multiple failures detected
pagerduty-bot: PD Incident created: PD1237999 — https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD1237999
Alice Nguyen: Acking — I'm primary oncall, taking lead. I'll post updates here.
Alice Nguyen: TL;DR: canary probe started failing ~12:03 UTC, ~85% failure rate across 10 probes in last 5m. Symptoms look like 5xx from upstream.
Marco Silva: I'm on, pulling prober + LB logs now.
Priya Patel: FYI no alert from customer-facing error rates yet, but edge latency for eu-west-1 spiked ~300ms at the same time.
Samir Rao: Quick repro from my laptop — intermittent 502 from the probe endpoint:
```bash
curl -i https://synth-canary.eu-west-1.redwood-inference/internal/health
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
...
```
Alice Nguyen: Probe fleet quick stats (from SynthMonitor): failing nodes 3/12, 10 checks in window, 85% fail. Error class: upstream 502/504.
Alice Nguyen: Mitigation plan: (1) suppress noisy PD pages for the probe (10m), (2) investigate LB/upstream, (3) rollback recent routing change if confirmed. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/synth-canary
Alice Nguyen: @Marco can you check LB route table + upstream health? @Priya can you draft a short customer-impact note if needed?
Marco Silva: LB logs show repeated 504s from backend host x10-03 and increased connection resets. Looks like a routing mismatch after last deploy. Starting rollback to previous route/pool.
pagerduty-bot: PD1237999 acknowledged by Alice Nguyen :white_check_mark:
Marco Silva: Rolling back with: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/backend-service -n eu-west-1 --to-revision=23`
```text
Rollout undo initiated
Deployment backend-service: revision 23 -> successful rollout in 90s
```
Priya Patel: Posting to ops-status: "Intermittent generation errors in eu-west-1 affecting synthetic checks. Mitigation in progress; no broad customer impact detected yet."
Alice Nguyen: Muting noisy synthetic probe while we remediate to avoid page storms. Will unmute after stabilization.
Samir Rao: Muting via synthctl: `synthctl mute --probe synth-canary-eu-west-1/probe-v2 --duration 10m --reason 'noise during rollback'`
incident-bot: Mute applied to probe (id: probe-9876) by Samir Rao
Marco Silva: Rollback complete. LB backend errors dropped to 0 in the tail logs. Re-enabling probe in 2m for warmup.
Alice Nguyen: Re-enable and re-run the canary checks.
Samir Rao: Unmuting now.
incident-bot: Probe recovered: success rate 100% over last 2m. No further failures observed.
Alice Nguyen: Closing PD incident. Root cause: routing change after deploy caused a subset of backends to serve 5xx. Remediation: rollback resolved the immediate problem. Follow-ups: add pre-deploy LB smoke test, and add circuit-breaker on probe alerts to prevent PD storms.
Priya Patel: Filing post-incident note and prelim customer impact: estimated 0.3% of generation requests affected for ~8m while the bad route was live; no sustained customer-facing outages.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks all. Passing to oncall rotation for postmortem ownership and action items: @oncall-rotation
pagerduty-bot: PD1237999 resolved by Alice Nguyen
